doc.title: David Spinozza interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, NY, September 27, 2025

title: A cover band and a one-album Mercury deal
summary: They played James Brown and Otis Redding covers; as Giant he later made one album for Mercury.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Did you have aspirations, as most bands do, of like, “Let’s make a record. Let’s get a deal.”

Well the thing was, it’s funny you said that. We were sort of a cover band. We didn’t really write a lot of originals. We were covering a lot of stuff: James Brown, Otis Redding, you know we played some Joe Tex. We were doing a lot of covers. So I don’t think we really dreamed too much about having a record deal. And then finally we did write some songs. We got a one deal thing with Mercury. I had a band called Giant and we did one album. And I wrote most of the stuff. But we weren’t thinking original songs, and that’s usually where it comes from. You have to write original material to get a record deal you know.
